messages.subject: Fine-tuning faceting plot -- correction
parts:
I only now found the online resource

http://bit.ly/hWyRZY


which really answers my questions.
Cheers

Lorenzo


> Dear All,
> Please consider the script at the end of the email.
> I have only customized a bit a plot with facets.
> To be precise, I customized every individual sub-panel, but I also would like to be able to customize the race and age labels (e.g. changing the color background, the font size etc...).
> Any suggestion is welcome.
> Cheers
>
> Lorenzo
>
> ###################################################################
> library("ggplot2")
>
> visual2 <- read.table("visual.txt", header=TRUE)
> gpl <- ggplot(visual2, aes(x=count, y=side,color=impaired)) +
> geom_point(size=2)+
> opts( panel.background=theme_rect(fill='white',size=1.5))+
> facet_grid(age ~ race)+
> xlab("New Count")+
> ylab(expression("New Side"))+
>
> opts(plot.title = theme_text(size = 25))+
> opts(axis.title.x = theme_text(size = 20))+
> opts(legend.text = theme_text(size = 14, vjust=0.4))+
> opts(legend.title = theme_text(size = 18,hjust=0))+
> opts(panel.grid.minor = theme_blank())+
> opts(axis.ticks = theme_segment(colour = "black", size=1),axis.ticks.length = unit(0.15, "cm"))+
> opts(panel.grid.major = theme_blank())+
> opts(## legend.position = c(0.7, 0.8),
> legend.background=theme_rect(col=0)
> ,legend.key = theme_rect(colour = NA))+
> opts(axis.title.y = theme_text(size = 20, angle=90))+
> opts(axis.text.x = theme_text(size=10, colour="black",vjust=1))+
> opts(axis.text.y = theme_text(size=15, colour="black", hjust=1.1))+
> scale_colour_manual("Functional", values=c(1,2))
>
> pdf("qplot_vision_2.pdf")
> print(gpl)
>
> dev.off()
>
> ###################################################################
